item.title: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy
item.description: The U.S. has added Megaspeed and six other companies to its trade blacklist over concerns about the potential diversion of advanced computing products.

item.title: Amazon faces FAA probe after delivery drone strikes Michigan fiber cable, garage
item.description: An Amazon drone "struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff," a preliminary FAA report stated.
